issues: Transductive features: spectral embedding is built from the kNN Tanimoto graph of train+test SMILES together. It uses the test molecules' structures but not their labels, so it is not a measurement violation, and it also applies in the final held-out scoring. Predictions do depend on which test molecules are scored together.
featurize() is computed again for the extra-trees model (redundant), and the new code assumes RADIUS/N_BITS are defined in the settings.
Recomputed z = (0.0906 - 0.08365) / (0.0049*sqrt(1/2+1/2)) ≈ 1.42, close to the harness's 1.425 (difference explained by rounding). The provisional reject is consistent.
